Lighthouse_1F_Text_Npc0.en: The tide here has not turned in\nyears. The lamp keeps waiting for a\pship.
Lighthouse_1F_Text_Npc0.fr: La marée n'a pas tourné ici depuis\ndes années. La lampe attend\ltoujours un navire.

Lighthouse_1F_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

Lighthouse_1F_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
Lighthouse_1F_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
